title: SpaceX Unveils Starbase, Louisiana Spaceport
summary: SpaceX has unveiled plans for Starbase, Louisiana, described as the largest private spaceport in the world.

title: CFD Modelling Cuts Network Rail Bridge Scour Costs
summary: Computational fluid dynamics modelling is reducing bridge scour prevention costs across Network Rail's asset base by improving assessment accuracy.

title: Ingestible Sensor Tracks Core Temperature
summary: MIT engineers have created an ingestible temperature sensor measuring six by four millimeters that can send continuous core body temperature updates.

title: Electra's Hybrid Aircraft Moves to Factory
summary: Electra's hybrid, fixed-wing aircraft, which originated as an MIT class project, has arrived at an Ohio factory.

title: WorldSync Improves Robotic World Models
summary: Researchers introduce WorldSync to align action-conditioned generation in robotic world models, improving policy evaluation and robot task success rates.

title: LAWA Architecture Enhances Robot Future Imagination
summary: LAWA uses compact latent actions to enable efficient test-time future imagination in world action models, improving robot control and success rates.

title: Coherent Direct D-MIMO Localization Framework
summary: Researchers present a unified family of Bayesian state-space filters for wideband near-field D-MIMO systems that operate directly on noisy channel observations.

title: Energy-Aware CNF Placement in O-RAN Edges
summary: This research investigates energy-aware joint placement and migration of cloud-native functions in an O-RAN edge cloud to minimize server and transmission energy.

title: Westinghouse Achieves eVinci Microreactor Criticality
summary: Westinghouse completed zero-power criticality testing for its eVinci microreactor at NCERC, validating the core design.

title: New Household Humanoid Robot Priced Under $1,700
summary: A San Francisco startup introduced a household humanoid robot designed to handle chores for US$1,688.

title: Fiber Bragg Grating Whiskers for Underwater Robots
summary: Seal-inspired fiber Bragg grating whiskers allow underwater robots to passively perceive hydrodynamic trails and vortices.

title: W-/D-Band Power Amplifier in 130 nm SiGe BiCMOS
summary: A wideband power amplifier implemented in a 130-nm SiGe BiCMOS process achieves a small-signal gain bandwidth of 71-133 GHz.

title: Ultra-Compact V-Band Power Amplifier in 22nm FD-SOI CMOS
summary: A differential millimeter-wave power amplifier using EDMOS transistors in a 22nm FD-SOI CMOS process achieves 18.8 dBm saturated output power.

title: NanoAvionics Launches MP42H Microsatellite Bus
summary: Kongsberg NanoAvionics is introducing its Gen-2 MP42 family of modular microsatellite buses designed for optical or SAR imaging missions.

title: Unvoiced Speech Regions Improve Audio Deepfake Detection
summary: An analysis of speech components shows that unvoiced regions are particularly effective in distinguishing synthetic deepfake speech from bonafide speech.

title: Dual-Based Weight Selection for Approximate Linear Programming
summary: A proposed dual-based method uses projected occupancy information from the ALP dual solution to construct a smooth stochastic policy.

title: VIP Framework for Efficient Robotic Navigation
summary: A variation-based iterative-learning planning framework directly updates planning commands as continuous functions in an infinite-dimensional space.

title: Gripper-Aware Vision Language Action Models for Robots
summary: Researchers introduce a multi-gripper dataset and a gripper-aware model to improve robotic grasping across five distinct gripper types.

title: Nordic Semiconductor Announces nRF93M1-LABA Smart Modem
summary: Nordic Semiconductor's multi-regional nRF93M1-LABA smart modem module is now generally available following Global Certification Forum compliance.

title: Transformer Model Enables Pilotless Multi-Receiver Wi-Fi Decoding
summary: Researchers developed a fully pilotless multi-access-point Wi-Fi receiver using a self-attention Transformer that achieves low error rates in cooperative configurations.

title: Fiber Optic Sensing Glove Tracks Full Hand Pose
summary: A new fiber optic glove uses multi-core shape-sensing fibers to capture full hand pose for dexterous manipulation and virtual teleoperation.

title: IBM Unveils 2nm Dual-Architecture Processor for Enterprise
summary: The new 2 nm processor supports Arm-native workloads alongside IBM environments with AI acceleration and encryption.

title: Nordson Launches Vantage XL for Panel-Level Packaging
summary: The fluid dispensing platform is designed for large semiconductor panels with thermal management, alignment, and warpage control.

title: Advantech Launches Dragonwing-Based Edge AI Solutions
summary: New industrial platforms support multi-camera vision, robotics, and automation with up to 100 TOPS of AI performance.

title: Optocouplers Mitigate EMI in Wide-Bandgap GaN and SiC Designs
summary: Advanced optocouplers provide necessary isolation to protect signal integrity and prevent logic corruption caused by electromagnetic interference in wide-bandgap designs.

title: Port of Dover Completes £53M Western Docks Revival Project
summary: McLaughlin and Harvey and Boskalis Westminster completed the £53M Dover Western Docks Revival Stage 3B project at the Port of Dover.

title: TSMC CoWoS Bottlenecks Create Packaging Opportunity for Intel
summary: Yield issues with TSMC's HBM-packaging could provide Intel a foundry opening as AI chipmakers evaluate alternative technologies.

title: World's First Laser-Beam Mosquito Shooter Available for Preorder
summary: A personal air defense system that tracks and shoots mosquitoes using a blue laser is now available for preorder.

title: Value Engineering Delivers Efficiencies for A9 Tomatin to Moy Project
summary: Value engineering exercises conducted during the tender stage and post contract award provided cost, carbon, and programme efficiencies for the project.

title: Physics-Constrained Deep Learning for Contactless Blood Pressure
summary: Researchers proposed a non-invasive blood pressure estimation framework using triaxial bodyseismography and physics-constrained deep learning.
